items.title: Pelle Larsson becomes the first player to ever score back-to-back 30pt games in the FIBA European Qualifiers
items.author: garret126
items.body_excerpt: Pelle Larsson scored back-to-back 30 point games for Sweden against Czechia and Finland, both victories for Sweden. This run ended against France, where he scored 24 points in a loss to France. He is averaging 26/3/2 in 4 games so far. Pelle Larsson will be a key part in the…

items.title: Sweden is tied with France at halftime. No one on France can keep Pelle Larsson from getting where he wants without fouling him. Larsson has 18 points at the half and is 10-for-12 on free throws.

items.title: Pelle Larsson was awesome for Sweden in their victory over Finland today: 31 points, 9-17 FG, 11-14 FT, 5 rebounds.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Pelle Larsson was awesome for Sweden in their victory over Finland today: 31 points, 9-17 FG, 11-14 FT, 5 rebounds.

Lauri Markkanen struggled for Finland: 11 points, 2-13 FG, 7-8 FT, 3 rebounds, 2 steals, 1 block.
